accessibility.gated_access_requirement: Requires Hugging Face account login and manual author approval ('You need to agree to share your Hugging Face information to access this dataset'). Unauthenticated /api/datasets, /raw/main/README.md, and datasets-server requests return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

license_and_origin.UPSTREAM_CONTENT_ORIGIN: Google Maps user-uploaded restaurant review photos and review text scraped via custom crawl_image pipeline
license_and_origin.card_ethics_disclaimer: Images are user-uploaded review photos on Google Maps and remain the copyright of their original authors. Released under CC BY-NC 4.0 for academic research and non-commercial experimentation only. Respect Google Maps' Terms of Service.
license_and_origin.project_owner_review_flag: AMBIGUOUS_UPSTREAM_RIGHTS: Repository author applies CC-BY-NC-4.0, which does not automatically override Google Maps Platform Terms of Service or third-party reviewer copyrights; however, dataset is independently disqualified by 0% geographic overlap with Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, and Hạ Long.

actual_schema.text_field_semantics: `text` is the original Google Maps user review text attached to `review_id`, and `text_translated` is its translated text; however, rows are keyed by `photo_id` (one row per food image), not by `review_id`.
actual_schema.address_quality: Street/ward/district address strings from Google Maps places in Hồ Chí Minh City

multiplicity_and_unique_review_analysis.duplicate_review_text_cause: A single Google Maps restaurant review (`review_id`) frequently contains 2 to 10+ food photos (`photo_id`). Because the dataset is flattened to one row per image, every photo from the same review duplicates `review_id`, `text`, `review_rating`, and `place_name`.

UNIQUE_REVIEW_ID_COUNT.explanation: While global UNIQUE_REVIEW_ID_COUNT across Hồ Chí Minh City requires reading the manual-gated 18.2 GB parquet shards, the exact UNIQUE_REVIEW_ID_COUNT in GoMate's three target cities (Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, Hạ Long) is deterministically 0 because 100.0% of all 34,104 rows belong to 9 districts of Hồ Chí Minh City.

canonical_mapping_to_freeze_v2.reason: gomate_places_freeze_v2.json contains 759 POIs across Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, Hạ Long, Hội An, Huế, and Nha Trang (0 in Hồ Chí Minh City). ThanThoai9x/vietnamese-food-images is 100% Hồ Chí Minh City (34,104 / 34,104 rows across 9 HCMC districts), so geographic and coordinate intersection with Freeze v2 is exactly 0 POIs.

rejection_reasons: Zero geographic overlap with Hà Nội (0), Đà Nẵng (0), and Hạ Long (0): 9 HCMC districts sum to 34,104 / 34,104 rows (100.0%).
100% food/restaurant category bias (0 attractions, culture, nature, beaches, or hotels).
Manual gated access (HTTP 401 without author approval) and 18.2 GB image-heavy payload.
Ambiguous upstream Google Maps ToS vs repository CC-BY-NC-4.0 license.

targeted_collection_alternatives_compari.title: Pre-Bound Canonical Freeze v2 POI Intake Template (60 POIs x 5 Reviews = 300 Reviews) with First-Party / Public-Research-Permitted Provenanced Curation
targeted_collection_alternatives_compari.data_obtainable: Full 17-field W07 target schema including exact pre-bound `poi_id` from gomate_places_freeze_v2.json, `upstream_place_id` (osm/overture), `city`, `rating`, `rating_scale_max`, `review_text` (Vietnamese/English), `language`, `created_at`, `collected_at`, `source_ref`, `provenance`, `license_or_usage_class`, `mapping_method = EXACT_UPSTREAM_ID`, `mapping_confidence = 1.0`.
targeted_collection_alternatives_compari.coverage: 100% balanced across Hà Nội (20 POIs), Đà Nẵng (20 POIs), and Hạ Long (20 POIs) and across all 5 tourism category groups (attractions/culture, nature/beach, restaurants/cafes/markets, hotels, other tourism).
targeted_collection_alternatives_compari.account_or_api_requirements: None (no paid API key, no credit card, no external approval delay).
targeted_collection_alternatives_compari.storage_and_reuse_constraints: Stored in gitignored `data/restricted/w07_reviews/` with deterministic SHA256 and provenance manifest committed in `data/manifests/`; first-party contributed or explicitly research-permitted reviews carry clean academic reuse rights.
targeted_collection_alternatives_compari.automation_feasibility: HIGH_FOR_SCAFFOLDING_AND_VALIDATION: Agent deterministically exports the 60-POI canonical template from Freeze v2 (`poi_id`, `name`, `city`, `category`, `lat`, `lng`, `osm_id`) and validates all 17 schema fields, deduplication, and provenance offline.
targeted_collection_alternatives_compari.scientific_reproducibility: HIGH: 100% deterministic `poi_id` binding before collection eliminates post-hoc entity-linking errors and guarantees reproducible SHA256 corpus freeze.
targeted_collection_alternatives_compari.risk: LOW (zero scraping, zero CAPTCHA/anti-bot bypass, zero platform ToS violation).

TARGETED_COLLECTION_GAPS.why_public_dataset_only_is_infeasible: 100% of audited public Vietnamese review datasets either strip POI identity/coordinates/city (`phamluan/vn_msa_sar_v3`, `VLSP2018-ABSA`, `pqthinh232/*`, `mendeley:10.17632/dp8s59xnb7.1`, `hienbm/tripadvisor_vietnam`) resulting in 0 deterministically mappable POIs, or cover only Hồ Chí Minh City restaurants (`ThanThoai9x/vietnamese-food-images`: 34,104 / 34,104 rows in 9 HCMC districts = 0 rows in Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, or Hạ Long).

USER_ACTION_REQUIRED.do_not_request_gated_thanthoai9x_downloa: Project Owner does NOT need to request gated access or download the 18.2 GB `ThanThoai9x/vietnamese-food-images` dataset because its public card `Areas` table proves 100.0% of its 34,104 rows are in 9 districts of Hồ Chí Minh City (0 rows in Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, or Hạ Long).
exact_owner_steps_after_w07_a1_audit_gat: STEP_1_APPROVE_COLLECTION_PATH: Confirm selection of Option 1/2 (Pre-Bound 60-POI Freeze v2 Canonical Intake Template at data/restricted/w07_reviews/w07_canonical_reviews_v1.jsonl with >= 5 real/provenanced reviews per POI = >= 300 reviews across Hà Nội [20 POIs], Đà Nẵng [20 POIs], and Hạ Long [20 POIs]).

STEP_2_POPULATE_OR_PROVIDE_LOCAL_FILE: Using the deterministic 60-POI canonical intake CSV/JSONL template generated from data/curated/gomate_places_freeze_v2.json (where poi_id, city, category, lat, lng, and osm_id are pre-filled), provide or approve >= 300 real/first-party/research-permitted reviews (>= 5 per POI) with source_ref, rating, language, created_at, and license_or_usage_class.

STEP_3_OPTIONAL_AUXILIARY_ABSA_APPROVAL: Confirm whether public ungated `phamluan/vn_msa_sar_v3` (CC-BY-4.0) should be used strictly in a separated auxiliary aspect-extraction test (never mixed into the primary POI-linked retrieval index).

EXPECTED_CATEGORY_COVERAGE.restaurant_bias_mitigation: Prevents a restaurant-only corpus: 70.0% of the Scientific Minimum corpus (42 / 60 POIs, 210 / 300 reviews) covers non-food tourism categories (attractions/culture 30%, hotels 25%, nature/beach 10%, other tourism 5%), matching GoMate's multi-category itinerary planner.
